briefs.fact: Tokyo core CPI +2.9% y/y in Nov, fastest since Jul 2025, vs 3.0% forecast; prior 2.6%; bolsters Dec BoJ hike case. Released Fri 27 Nov (Reuters).
briefs.headline: Core inflation 2.9%, a 16-month high

briefs.fact: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Turkiye open joint defence pact (Mecca alliance) meeting in Islamabad, 27-28 Nov.
briefs.headline: Mecca-alliance defence talks open

briefs.fact: Three months after 26 Aug Bhote Koshi flood, survivors still in temporary shelter; WFP seeks $28M; govt confirmed 3,915 of 5,285 missing.
briefs.headline: Flood survivors in tents, 3 months on

briefs.fact: Colombo Fort Magistrate's Court refuses to lift ex-president Gotabaya Rajapaksa's travel ban; asks CID whether he will be named an Easter attacks suspect. Fri 27 Nov.
briefs.headline: Court blocks Gotabaya Singapore trip

briefs.fact: Maaveerar Naal marked 27 Nov under tight restrictions in the North-East; man arrested in Mannar over banner and flag; ruling NPP told members not to attend LTTE-fighter events.
briefs.headline: Remembrance day held under tight policing

briefs.fact: PM Le Minh Hung in Hanoi Fri 27 Nov: Vietnam expects a trade deal soon; tariff 'far below' the 35% proposed. Reaction to USTR Section 301 findings of 25 Nov.
briefs.headline: PM: deal soon, tariff 'far below 35%'

briefs.fact: Myanmar government says it will not comply with 'inappropriate' parts of the ICJ ruling on crimes against humanity against the Rohingya. Fri 27 Nov.
briefs.headline: Rejects parts of ICJ Rohingya ruling

briefs.fact: Indonesia gold-mine flood: at least 13 dead, rescue continues for those trapped. Use 13, not 'dozens'.
briefs.headline: Gold-mine flood kills at least 13

briefs.fact: 2nd Test, Hagley Oval: India won toss, fielded. NZ 246/5 at stumps (85 overs): Latham 59, Blundell 53*, Phillips 36*; Akash Deep 2-52.
briefs.headline: NZ 246/5 on day one at Christchurch

briefs.fact: Consumer NZ: of products tracked 3 months, half were the SAME price or CHEAPER at other times; 1 in 3 retailers raised sales this year ('Black November').
briefs.headline: Half of NZ 'deals' no cheaper at all

briefs.fact: Australian PGA day 2, The Lakes: von Dellingshausen -13 after 64 (albatross on par-5 14th); McKibbin -10, Cam Smith -9.
briefs.headline: Von Dellingshausen leads at -13 in Sydney

briefs.fact: Australia places counter-terrorism financing sanctions Fri 27 Nov on Zohair Hassib and Kazem Hamad for orchestrating IRGC-linked antisemitic arson attacks (Sydney, Melbourne, 2024). FM Penny Wong.
briefs.headline: Hassib, Hamad sanctioned over arson

hero.deck: Coalition 65 of 130 — Opportunity Party's 7 seats decide who governs
hero.fact: NZ final count Fri 14:00 NZDT: National 40 + ACT 13 + NZ First 12 = 65/130, one short of 66; Opportunity Party 7 = kingmaker.
hero.headline: ONE SEAT SHORT

briefs.fact: Europa League, Batumi (moved from Istanbul): halted ~30 min (UEFA) at min 25/26; Georgian police enter stands, pepper spray Besiktas fans over pro-Palestine banners; Besiktas win 2-1. Ended Fri 02:00 WIB.
briefs.headline: Besiktas win 2-1 after 30-min halt

briefs.fact: FIDE World Championship, Geneva: Game 3 drawn after 60 moves, third straight draw; Sindarov down to 6-8 sec before move-40 control. Fri 27 Nov = first rest day; Game 4 Sat 28 Nov.
briefs.headline: Gukesh–Sindarov draw again, 1.5–1.5

briefs.fact: UK government contacts 100,000 retired military personnel to prepare for possible military action — first time since the end of the Cold War.
briefs.headline: 100,000 veterans called up for readiness

briefs.fact: Finland–Sweden CV90 buy: 160 CV9035 Mk IV, €1.955bn initial / €2.835bn programme, 5-nation joint buy of 400+; contract signing ceremony Fri 27 Nov ~noon at Swedish Army Museum, Stockholm.
briefs.headline: Signs €2.8bn deal for 160 CV90 vehicles

briefs.fact: Overnight Fri 27 Nov: drones strike Yefremov Synthetic Rubber Plant, Tula (HTPB solid rocket fuel for Iskander) + nearby power plant; St Petersburg also hit. Zelenskyy: strikes in 11 Russian regions in a week; Russia claims 318 drones downed.
briefs.headline: Ukraine drones hit Iskander-fuel plant

briefs.fact: Muslim World League condemns the attack on the Jazan refinery; Brent crude climbs past $97. Reaction Fri 27 Nov (strike itself 26 Nov — see DATE CHECK).
briefs.headline: Condemns attack on Jazan refinery

briefs.fact: Hamas weighs response as Israeli strikes escalate; Thu strikes killed 2 near Al-Mahatta Park, Gaza City; 4 homes hit in east Gaza City; 10 Palestinians killed in latest strikes.
briefs.headline: Hamas weighs reply as strikes grow

briefs.fact: Two Syrian Arab Army soldiers killed by unidentified assailants on the al-Quniya–al-Sanamayn road, northern Daraa countryside. SANA, Fri 27 Nov.
briefs.headline: 2 soldiers killed in Daraa attack

briefs.fact: Iraq blocks/closes two border crossings in the Kurdistan region with Syria and Iran. Fri 27 Nov.
briefs.headline: Shuts 2 Kurdistan crossings to Syria, Iran

hero.deck: 110 downed · 27 sites hit · power out in 6 oblasts
hero.fact: Russia launches 155 drones from 18:00 Thu 26 Nov (83 jet Shahed + Gerbera + decoys); by 08:00 Fri 110 downed/jammed; hits at 27 sites; 6 dead, 25 hurt; power out in 6 oblasts.
hero.headline: 155 DRONES IN ONE NIGHT

banner.deck: Bears 39–35 · Eagles 39–38 · Bills 13–10 — first time in NFL history
banner.fact: First day in NFL history with three final-minute winners (Elias Sports Bureau): Bears 39-35 Lions, Eagles 39-38 Cowboys (59-yd FG), Bills 13-10 Chiefs.
banner.headline: THREE GAMES, THREE FINAL-MINUTE WINNERS

briefs.fact: Chicago win 39-35 at Detroit; go-ahead TD Williams to Odunze 6 yd, 3 sec left; Bears erase 35-24 deficit in final 8 min; Bears 9-2, end Detroit's 6-game win streak. Ended Fri 04:30 WIB.
briefs.headline: 39–35: Williams TD with 3 seconds left

briefs.fact: FG 59 yard Jake Elliott, 2 sec left; Eagles rally from 21 down, score final 15 pts, 22 in Q4; Joe Milton 331 yd, 3 TD. Use 59 yd (Reuters + AFP), not 60.
briefs.headline: 39–38: Elliott 59-yd FG, 2 seconds left

briefs.fact: FG 57 yard Tyler Bass as time expires, heavy rain; James Cook 117 yd + TD; Bills 10-1, 7th straight win; Mahomes 16/29, 174 yd.
briefs.headline: 13–10: Bass 57-yd FG at the gun in rain

briefs.fact: Thanksgiving storm: 56-mph gust at LaGuardia, New York; 500,000+ homes/businesses without power; hundreds of flights cancelled; ~80M travelling. Peak Thu afternoon US = Fri early WIB.
briefs.headline: 56-mph gusts; 500,000 lose power

briefs.fact: US markets reopen Fri 09:30 ET, close early 13:00 ET; S&P 500 futures +0.7-0.8% point to a stronger Black Friday session; November discounts bigger than last year (Salesforce). Friday close NOT YET — see Saturday slots.
briefs.headline: US markets reopen, close early at 1pm

briefs.fact: 100th Macy's parade postponed to Sat 28 Nov 08:30 ET (first weather postponement in 100 years); balloons deflated Wed, taken to New Jersey, re-inflated Fri afternoon with NO public viewing; NBC airs 2025 replay.
briefs.headline: Balloons re-inflated; parade moves to Sat

briefs.fact: CDMX civil protection (SGIRPC) special notice Thu 26 Nov; CONAGUA/SMN: first winter storm of the season; rain starts Fri 27 Nov ~15:00, 50-70mm (possibly year's heaviest), max 8-13C, min -2C, sleet/snow possible in high south/west Fri night-Sat morning; 'Operativo Tlaloque 2.0' at 52 critical points. Jefa de Gobierno Clara Brugada.
briefs.headline: First winter storm: rain from 3pm

briefs.fact: FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar: final group games Fri 27 Nov (Groups I-L, 8 matches, 16:00-19:00 Doha) complete the knockout field; seven African teams through. Morocco/Senegal qualification itself was Thu 26 Nov — see DATE CHECK.
briefs.headline: Final group games decide knockout field

briefs.fact: Transition President Horta Inta-a decree 00:15 Fri 27 Nov: elections delayed to Nov 2028, extending the promised ~1-year transition by ~2 years.
briefs.headline: Military govt delays vote to 2028

briefs.fact: Uganda to withdraw troops from a town in DR Congo amid a diplomatic dispute. Africa Today (Fri 27 Nov) via GhanaWeb.
briefs.headline: Pulls troops from DR Congo town

briefs.fact: Power outage hits OR Tambo Airport (Johannesburg); passengers stuck in long queues. eNCA, Fri 27 Nov 06:15 GMT.
briefs.headline: Blackout strands Joburg passengers

briefs.fact: Kenyan court: ex-Migori governor Okoth Obado sentenced to 25 years for the murder of Sharon Otieno. Different case from the KWS ruling of 26 Nov (DATE CHECK). The Standard, Fri 27 Nov 09:02 GMT.
briefs.headline: Obado jailed 25 years for Otieno murder

briefs.fact: Egypt orders pre-trial detention and drug tests for the Al-Warraq crash suspect. Follow-up Fri 27 Nov (crash itself 25 Nov: fuel-truck fire, Ring Road Cairo, 31 dead — DATE CHECK).
briefs.headline: Al-Warraq crash suspect held, drug-tested

briefs.fact: Lagos cancels Saturday sanitation because of INEC mock accreditation. Punch, Fri 27 Nov 11:07 GMT.
briefs.headline: Saturday sanitation off over INEC drill

briefs.fact: COMEX Feb gold futures +4% to $3,708.40 Fri morning (session high $3,712.80), up $143.80 from Wed settlement $3,564.60, rebounding from 52-week low $3,425.20 Wed; silver +10% to ~$43.94. Friday-morning levels, not closes.
briefs.headline: Jumps 4% to $3,708 in Friday rebound
